description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_ListStyle, which validates the CSS shorthand property 'list-style'. It includes methods for constructing the validator with configuration data and validating a string against CSS list-style rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_ListStyle
